title: eludite.file.close input
description: Close a document tab (its close button). A document with unsaved changes is closed only when save says what to do with them; the UI asks the user (Save, Don't Save, Cancel) and passes the answer.

path.description: Document tab id: the absolute path of an open file (or the id of another document tab, such as welcome).

save.description: For a document with unsaved changes: save writes it first, discard drops the changes. Required when the document is dirty.
